description: nvim-jay (docs/nvim-jay.md §7): the snap hook before each shell command, the reply hook when the agent stops and when a sub-agent starts or ends. Each runs the Lua hook nvim-jay writes on this machine (~/.config/nvim-jay; Windows: under %USERPROFILE%) with nvim -l, found on PATH or where Homebrew, Linux and docs/windows.md put it; it runs a hook file only if it is yours: macOS, Linux: the real file (links followed) and its folder owned by you, under your home, not group- or world-writable; Windows: under %USERPROFILE% with no link or junction on the way. Otherwise, no hook file or no nvim: nothing, exit 0. command: macOS, Linux, Claude Code on Windows (Git Bash); commandWindows: Codex on Windows (PowerShell).

hooks.command: f="${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}/.config/nvim-jay/snap_hook.lua"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; i=0; while [ -L "$f" ] && [ $i -lt 9 ]; do l=$(readlink "$f"); case $l in /*) f=$l;; *) f=${f%/*}/$l;; esac; i=$((i+1)); done; d=$(cd -P "${f%/*}" && pwd -P) && h=$(cd -P "${USERPROFILE:-$HOME}" && pwd -P) || exit 0; f=$d/${f##*/}; case $d/ in "$h"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ] && [ "$(find "$d" "$f" -prune -user "$(id -u)" ! -perm -020 ! -perm -002 | grep -c .)" = 2 ] || exit 0; for n in "$(command -v nvim)" /opt/homebrew/bin/nvim /usr/local/bin/nvim "$HOME/.local/bin/nvim" "$LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/nvim-win64/bin/nvim.exe" "${ProgramFiles:-C:/Program Files}/Neovim/bin/nvim.exe" "$USERPROFILE/scoop/shims/nvim.exe"; do [ -x "$n" ] && { "$n" --clean -l "$f"; exit 0; }; done; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: try { $h = $env:USERPROFILE; $c = $h + '/.config'; $d = $c + '/nvim-jay'; $f = $d + '/snap_hook.lua'; if ($h -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf) -and -not (Get-Item -LiteralPath $c, $d, $f -Force | Where-Object { $_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint })) { $n = @((Get-Command nvim -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Ignore).Source) + @(($env:LOCALAPPDATA + '/Programs/nvim-win64/bin/nvim.exe'), ($env:ProgramFiles + '/Neovim/bin/nvim.exe'), ($h + '/scoop/shims/nvim.exe')) | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($n) { try { [Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false } catch {}; & $n --clean -l $f } } } catch {}; exit 0
